hindi: संस्थाध्यक्ष पण्य-संस्था में अपने दस्तावेज़ों से विशुद्ध पुराने माल के गिरवी रखने या बेचने की व्यवस्था स्थापित करे।
english: The superintendent of the saṃsthā should establish, in the paṇya-saṃsthā (the establishment for wares), the pledge or sale of old goods that are cleared by their own documents.
notes: saṃsthā is left as saṃsthā (commonly taken as "market" or "standing establishment"); the office is not translated further. karaṇa is rendered "document" (alternative: "means, instrument"); sva-karaṇa-viśuddha could also mean "cleared by their own means". sthāpayet is caus. "should cause to stand / establish"; the object (ādhāna, vikraya) is not further specified.

words.gloss: from the malpractice of the pautava

hindi: और तुला, मान और भाण्डों का निरीक्षण करे, पौतव के अपचार के कारण।
english: And he should inspect the balances, measures and vessels, on account of malpractice by the pautava.
notes: pautava kept untranslated (the officer or office concerned with weights and measures is a later gloss, not stated here). bhāṇḍa may be "vessels" or "goods"; read here as a third item beside tulā and māna. The ablative is read as cause ("on account of").

words.gloss: of the parimāṇī and the droṇa
deficiency or excess of half a pala

hindi: परिमाणी और द्रोण में आधे पल की कमी या अधिकता दोष नहीं है।
english: In the parimāṇī and the droṇa, a deficiency or an excess of half a pala is no fault.
notes: parimāṇī, droṇa, pala (and later karṣa, āḍhaka, paṇa) are units kept as names. The dual may be genitive ("of") or locative ("in"); the sense is the same. hīna-atiriktam is neuter though adoṣaḥ is masculine; read as a predicate.

words.gloss: in deficiency or excess of a pala

hindi: पल की कमी या अधिकता होने पर बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: In a deficiency or excess of a pala, the fine is twelve paṇas.

hindi: इससे पल के साथ बढ़ने वाली दण्ड की वृद्धि समझाई गई है।
english: By this, the increase of the fine that rises by a pala is explained.
notes: uttarā is read "following, increasing by"; so each further pala adds to the fine by the same rule.

words.gloss: deficiency or excess of a karṣa

hindi: तुला में कर्ष की कमी या अधिकता दोष नहीं है।
english: In a balance, a deficiency or an excess of a karṣa is no fault.

words.gloss: in deficiency or excess of two karṣas

hindi: दो कर्ष की कमी या अधिकता होने पर छह पण का दण्ड है।
english: In a deficiency or excess of two karṣas, the fine is six paṇas.

hindi: इससे कर्ष के साथ बढ़ने वाली दण्ड की वृद्धि समझाई गई है।
english: By this, the increase of the fine that rises by a karṣa is explained.

words.gloss: deficiency or excess of half a karṣa

hindi: आढक में आधे कर्ष की कमी या अधिकता दोष नहीं है।
english: For an āḍhaka, a deficiency or an excess of half a karṣa is no fault.
notes: In the e-text "āḍhakasya-ardha" is an unsandhied join of two words (the print has sandhi).

words.gloss: in deficiency or excess of a karṣa

hindi: कर्ष की कमी या अधिकता होने पर तीन पण का दण्ड है।
english: In a deficiency or excess of a karṣa, the fine is three paṇas.

hindi: इससे कर्ष के साथ बढ़ने वाली दण्ड की वृद्धि समझाई गई है।
english: By this, the increase of the fine that rises by a karṣa is explained.

words.gloss: of the kinds of balances and measures

hindi: इनसे अन्य तुला और मान के भेदों के विषय में अनुमान करे।
english: For the kinds of balances and measures other than these, he should make an inference.
notes: anumāna is kept literal ("inference"); the text does not say what is inferred (presumably the fine and tolerance by analogy). ataḥ anyeṣām is read "other than this".

words.gram: pres. part. mid. gen. sg. vi-√krī

hindi: अधिक तुला और मान से खरीदकर कम तुला और मान से बेचने वाले के लिए वही दण्ड दुगुने हैं।
english: For one who buys with an excessive balance and measure and sells with deficient ones, those very fines are doubled.
notes: "ta eva" = te eva ("te" before a vowel).

hindi: गिनती के मालों में, मालों के मूल्यों में से आठवाँ भाग हर लेने वाले पर छियानवे का दण्ड है।
english: In the case of countable wares, for one who takes away an eighth part from the prices of wares, the fine is ninety-six.
notes: The unit of the fine (paṇas) is not stated. gaṇya = "to be counted" (countable). ṣaṇ.ṇavatiḥ is regular sandhi of ṣaṭ + navatiḥ.

words.gloss: made of wood, iron or jewels
made of rope, leather or clay
made of thread, bark or hair

hindi: लकड़ी, लोहे या मणि से बने, या रस्सी, चमड़े या मिट्टी से बने, या सूत, छाल या बाल से बने, असली न होने वाले माल को “असली” के रूप में बिक्री या गिरवी में लगाने वाले पर मूल्य का आठ गुना दण्ड है।
english: For one who puts into sale or pledge an article that is not genuine — made of wood, iron or jewels, or made of rope, leather or clay, or made of thread, bark or hair — as “genuine”, the fine is eight times the price.

text_flags.why: possible: retroflex ṇ where the usual sandhi of mṛd + maya is mṛnmaya (dental n); some editions do print ṇ

notes: jātya rendered "genuine" (literally of good stock); the quotation “genuine” is closed by iti (closing particle). nayataḥ = "of one who leads/puts (it) into" sale or pledge.

hindi: जो सारहीन माल को “सारयुक्त माल” के रूप में, उससे उत्पन्न न होने वाले को “उससे उत्पन्न” के रूप में, उपधि से युक्त को “राधा से युक्त” के रूप में, अथवा समुद्ग-परिवर्तिम माल को बिक्री या गिरवी में लगाता है, उस पर कम मूल्य वाले माल में चौवन पण का दण्ड है; एक पण के मूल्य वाले में दुगुना; दो पण के मूल्य वाले में दो सौ।
english: For one who puts into sale or pledge goods without substance as “goods of substance”, goods not born of that as “born of that”, goods endowed with upadhi as “endowed with rādhā”, or casket-exchanged goods (samudga-parivartima): for [goods] of lower price the fine is fifty-four paṇas; for [goods] priced at one paṇa, [the fine is] double; for [goods] priced at two paṇas, [the fine is] two hundred.

text_flags.why: possible: the e-text elsewhere marks compound members with "."; the mark is missing here

notes: Obscure terms kept with literal glosses only: rādhā (untranslated; sense uncertain), upadhi (often "deceit, substitute"), samudga-parivartima (samudga "casket, box" + parivartima "obtained by exchange"). tat-jāta "born of that" does not say what "that" is. hīna-mūlya "of lower price" probably means lower than one paṇa, since it precedes paṇa-mūlya and dvi-paṇa-mūlya. The amount for paṇa-mūlya (double) is not stated as a number.

hindi: इससे मूल्य की वृद्धि होने पर दण्ड की वृद्धि समझाई गई है।
english: By this, in a rise of price, the increase of the fine is explained.

words.gloss: lowering of the quality of work

words.gram: pres. part. caus. gen. pl. sam-ut-√sthā

hindi: जो कारु और शिल्पी मिलकर कर्म के गुण में गिरावट, जीविका, या क्रय-विक्रय में बाधा उत्पन्न करते हैं, उन पर एक हजार का दण्ड है।
english: For artisans and craftsmen who, joining together, bring about a lowering of the quality of work, or livelihood (ājīva), or an obstruction of sale and purchase, the fine is a thousand.
notes: ājīva is left as "livelihood"; it may mean livelihood-profit or wages, and the sense "a rise in" it is probably meant but is not stated. samutthāpayatām governs all three objects. The unit of the fine is not stated.

hindi: अथवा जो वैदेहक मिलकर माल रोकते हैं, या अनर्घ मूल्य पर बेचते हैं, उन पर एक हजार का दण्ड है।
english: Or for traders who, joining together, hold back wares, or who sell at an anargha [price], the fine is a thousand.
notes: anargha kept (literally "without worth / priceless"); the likely sense is a price out of proportion to the worth, but this is not stated. avarundhatām = "of those who obstruct / hold back"; the alternative "confine, hoard" is close.

words.gloss: from the price of a paṇa
by a fault of the hand

hindi: धरक या मायक पर, जो हाथ के दोष से, पण के मूल्य के आठवें भाग का, तुला और मान का अन्तर, या मूल्य और रंग का अन्तर करता है, दो सौ का दण्ड है।
english: For a dharaka or a māyaka who practises, by a fault of the hand, a difference of balance and measure, or a difference of price and colour, [amounting to] an eighth part of the price of a paṇa, the fine is two hundred.
notes: The stand-alone "-" in the e-text is the editors' dash and is left as a token. dharaka and māyaka are kept untranslated (possibly weigher and measurer, from √dhṛ and √mā). varṇa is rendered "colour" (alternative: "quality, kind"). The order of the Sanskrit is rearranged in the translation.

hindi: इससे दो सौ के साथ बढ़ने वाली दण्ड की वृद्धि समझाई गई है।
english: By this, the increase of the fine that rises by two hundred is explained.

words.gloss: of articles of grain, oil, sugar, salt, fragrant and medicinal kinds
in the adding of one of like colour

hindi: अनाज, तेल, क्षार, नमक, गन्ध और औषध द्रव्यों में समान रंग मिलाने पर बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: In the adding of a like-coloured [substance] to articles of grain, oil, sugar, salt, fragrant things and medicinal things, the fine is twelve paṇas.
notes: kṣāra follows the glossary (sugar); its literal sense is "alkali, ash-salt". sneha = oil or fat. Whether gandha and bhaiṣajya are two further members or modify dravya is not settled; here "fragrant things and medicinal things". The thing added is not named in the Sanskrit (sama-varṇa-upadhāna = adding of like colour).

hindi: जो दिया गया हो और जिससे वे निर्वाह करें, उसे इनके दिन में उत्पन्न होने वाले को गिनकर वणिक् निश्चित करे।
english: What has been allotted, on which they may live — that of theirs which arises in a day, a merchant should fix after reckoning.
notes: Unclear: who "they" and "these" are (the sellers of the preceding rules?), what niṣṛṣṭa refers to (allotted, released, granted), and who the vaṇik is. The rendering is literal; confidence low. sthāpayet = "should fix".

hindi: क्रेता और विक्रेता के बीच जो पड़ता है, वह आदाय से भिन्न है।
english: What falls between the buyer and the seller is other than the ādāya.
notes: ādāya kept untranslated in the translation (literally "taking, income, revenue"); the sense of the rule is unclear without commentary. antara-patita is "fallen in the interval". The dual may be genitive or locative ("of / between").

hindi: और इससे अनुमति पाए हुए लोग अनाज और माल का संचय कर सकते हैं।
english: And by this, those who are permitted may make stores of grain and wares.
notes: tena ("by this") refers back to the preceding rule; ca links the sentence with the earlier ones. "Those who are permitted" is left unspecified in the Sanskrit.

hindi: इनका जो अन्यथा संचित हो, उसे पण्याध्यक्ष ले ले।
english: What of these has been stored otherwise [than so], the Superintendent of Wares should take.
notes: gṛhṇīyāt is kept literal ("take"); "confiscate" would be an interpretation. anyathā refers to storing other than as permitted in unit 25.

words.gloss: in the sale of grain and wares

hindi: इससे अनाज और माल की बिक्री में प्रजा के प्रति अनुग्रह के साथ व्यवहार करे।
english: By this, in the sale of grain and wares, he should deal with favour to the people.
notes: The subject (presumably the Superintendent of Wares) is not stated. prajānām is read as "to the people", the object of the favour.

hindi: और अनुमत क्रय से ऊपर इनके स्वदेशी मालों में सौ पर पाँच जीविका स्थापित करे, परदेशी मालों में दस।
english: And beyond the permitted purchase, for these wares of one's own country he should fix the livelihood (ājīva) at five per hundred; for those of another country, at ten [per hundred].
notes: pañcakaṃ śatam is read "five (to the) hundred"; ājīva is "livelihood" (probably the allowed profit; sense not stated). The unit (paṇas) is not given.

hindi: उससे आगे जो खरीद या बिक्री में मूल्य बढ़ाते हैं, या उसे उत्पन्न कराते हैं, उन पर सौ पण में पाँच पण से दो सौ का दण्ड है।
english: Beyond that, for those who raise the price, or bring [it] about, in purchase or sale, the fine is two hundred, [counted] from five paṇas in a hundred paṇas.
notes: bhāvayatām is doubtful: "bring about, cause to be" (as read) or "value, make out (a price)". paṇa-śate pañca-paṇāt is read "in a hundred paṇas, from five paṇas (onward)", i.e. beyond the five per hundred allowed in unit 28; the exact computation is not stated. Confidence low.

hindi: इससे मूल्य की वृद्धि होने पर दण्ड की वृद्धि समझाई गई है।
english: By this, in a rise of price, the increase of the fine is explained.

hindi: और इनके मिलकर किए गए क्रय में, न बिके रहने पर, दूसरा सम्मिलित क्रय न दे।
english: And in a joint purchase of these, [while it is] unsold, he should not give another joint purchase.
notes: "Give" is literal (grant / allow). What is unsold (the earlier joint purchase) is not stated; avikrīte is read as a locative absolute.

hindi: और इनके माल की हानि होने पर अनुग्रह करे।
english: And in damage to the wares of these, he should show favour.

hindi: माल की अधिकता के कारण पण्याध्यक्ष सब माल एकमुख बेचे।
english: Because of the abundance of wares, the Superintendent of Wares should sell all the wares one-mouthed (eka-mukha).
notes: eka-mukha is kept literal ("one-mouthed"); it is commonly taken as "through a single outlet", i.e. only through him, but the text does not say so.

hindi: उनके न बिके रहने पर दूसरे न बेचें।
english: While those are unsold, others should not sell.

hindi: वे उन्हें दिन के वेतन पर बेचें, प्रजा के प्रति अनुग्रह के साथ। परन्तु देश और काल से अन्तरित मालों का —
english: They should sell those for a day's wage, with favour to the people. But of wares separated by place and time —
notes: GROUPING: the last three tokens ("deśa-kāla-antaritānāṃ tu paṇyānāṃ -") begin the next sentence, which continues through both lines of unit 36 ("... sthāpayed argham arghavit"); they belong with unit 36. The verse number "35" with its bars is printed inside the unit and is kept as tokens. divasa-vetana "a day's wage" is literal; who receives it is not stated.

hindi: मूल्य जानने वाला प्रक्षेप, माल की निष्पत्ति, शुल्क, वृद्धि, अवक्रय और अन्य व्ययों की गणना करके मूल्य स्थापित करे।
english: Having reckoned the addition (prakṣepa), the production of the wares, the toll, the increase, the avakraya and the other expenditures, one who knows prices should fix the price.
notes: GROUPING: this verse completes the sentence begun at the end of unit 35 ("But of wares separated by place and time —"); read together: "of wares separated by place and time, one who knows prices should fix the price after reckoning ...". prakṣepa ("addition, outlay") and vṛddhi ("increase", possibly interest) are rendered literally; avakraya is kept untranslated (possibly "hire, rent" or "buying back"), sense uncertain.
